inherited_criterion.roadmap_text: B0099 states the audited builder order exactly, preserves fresh temporary-directory execution and byte comparison, and states that canonical output changes require passing validation and the explicit refresh path; the theorem values and frozen Route record are unchanged.

operationalization.fully_addressed: B0099 states the audited executable order exactly: isolated proof-guard and finite-traversal reconstruction precede the build-validation source and upstream lock checks; it also preserves fresh temporary-directory verify-only execution and byte comparison, states that canonical outputs can change only after passing validation through the explicit refresh path, and leaves the theorem values and frozen Route record unchanged.
operationalization.partially_addressed: B0099 makes a genuine sequencing correction but leaves at least one part of the executable order ambiguous or omits one of the committed safeguards—fresh temporary-directory execution, byte comparison, passing validation, explicit refresh—or fails to preserve the theorem values and frozen Route record explicitly.
operationalization.made_worse_discriminator: B0099 describes the builder order less accurately than the Round-1 record, further reverses or obscures the reconstruction and lock-check sequence, weakens the verify-only temporary-directory, byte-comparison, validation, or explicit-refresh safeguards, or implies a change to the theorem values or frozen Route record.

items.expected_change_surface: B0099 in Independent replay obligations and any matching reader-facing reproducibility summary of the executable replay order.

inherited_criterion.roadmap_text: The Round-8 test record directly exercises repeated Delta cancellation, sign-normalization idempotence, both inverse orders, and canonical collisions, and B0048 matches that direct coverage. Any independent closure statement identifies a separately implemented recomputation and an exact replay artifact; otherwise the manuscript makes no independence claim for closure assurance.

operationalization.fully_addressed: The Round-8 test record contains direct, localized exercises of repeated Delta cancellation, sign-normalization idempotence under global negation, both generator/inverse multiplication orders, and sampled canonical collisions, while B0048 accurately describes that direct coverage; any claimed independent closure assurance is tied to a separately implemented recomputation and an exact replay artifact, and in their absence no independence claim is made.
operationalization.partially_addressed: The test record directly exercises a genuine subset of the committed canonicalization properties or B0048 improves its coverage description, but one or more required properties remain indirect, B0048 does not match the direct tests, or a closure-independence statement lacks either a separately implemented recomputation or its exact replay artifact.
operationalization.made_worse_discriminator: The test record removes or weakens direct coverage of a committed canonicalization property, B0048 overstates the tests more than the Round-1 record, or a same-builder or unaudited closure path is newly represented as independent assurance without a separate implementation and exact replay artifact.

items.expected_change_surface: The Round-8 canonicalization and closure regression-test record, its exact replay evidence if independence is claimed, and B0048's manuscript description of the exercised invariants.
